permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.intro: Control the capabilities available to each role and grant individual exceptions to specific users. Capabilities are enforced on both the server and the interface — changes here take effect on the next request.
permissions.adminHint: Administrators always hold every capability. This role cannot be edited.
permissions.roleHint: Choose the capabilities this role grants. Users with individual overrides keep them.
permissions.userSelectEmptyDesc: Pick a user from the list above to view or edit their capability overrides.
permissions.overrideHint: Individual overrides layer on top of the {role} role.

capability.system.bypass_expiry: Exempts the account from expiry. Administrators always hold this capability.

users.title: User management
users.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to permanently delete user {username}? This cannot be undone.
users.confirmDeletePassword: Enter your password to confirm deletion
users.formAdminPasswordRequired: Admin password is required to confirm
users.resetNewPasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to generate a random password
users.resetTempPasswordHint: A temporary password was generated. Copy it now — it will not be shown again. The user will be required to change it at first sign-in.

settings.title: System settings
settings.opsIntro: Admin operations performed on demand. Safe to run repeatedly — they do not duplicate existing data. Normally run automatically via cron; these buttons are for manual runs.
settings.examDurationHint: The default duration for an exam session
settings.rankRefreshDesc: Updates each user's trust score and question count from their current data, which recomputes author ranks (authority, expert, contributor, etc.).
settings.rankRefreshLast: Last result: {updated} updated out of {scanned} users.
settings.rankRefreshNone: No changes — all values are up to date ({scanned} users scanned)
settings.seedDesc: Adds the demo question set to the bank — ten standalone questions and two linked clinical cases (major depression, first psychotic episode) for demonstration and testing. Existing questions are not added again.

database.exportTitleHint: This title appears in the PDF header and filename only. Excel / CSV / JSON formats ignore it. Leave empty for the default title.
database.title: Database information
database.exportStateDesc: Export categories, tags, cases, and questions as a single JSON file with natural keys — imports cleanly into an empty database with no ID remapping.
database.filtersHint: Optional. Leave every field empty to export all questions. Filters apply to every export format (Excel / CSV / JSON / PDF).
database.filtersSearchHint: Search text, explanation, and source (min 2 characters)
database.restoreConfirm: The current database will be replaced by the backup {name}. A safety backup will be created automatically before the restore.
database.restorePasswordPlaceholder: Enter your admin password to confirm
database.dangerDesc: Clearing the database will delete all questions ({questions}) and {sessions} self-study sessions. A backup will be created automatically before clearing. This operation cannot be undone.
database.clearAdminPasswordPlaceholder: Enter your admin password to confirm

tags.title: Tag management
tags.emptyDesc: Tags appear when added to questions
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete tag "{name}"? The tag will be removed from all questions.
tags.mergeCount: {count} tags will be merged into one.
tags.mergeSameError: A tag cannot be merged into itself

groups.title: Group management
groups.emptyDesc: Create a group and add members to appear on the leaderboard.
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete group "{name}"? All members will be removed.
groups.emptyMembersDesc: Add members to appear on the leaderboard.

blueprints.title: Exam blueprints
blueprints.emptyDesc: Create a blueprint to distribute questions across categories by weight.
blueprints.name: Blueprint name
blueprints.weightsHint: Set a weight for each category. Weights are relative — the sum does not need to be 100. Leave all weights at 0 for a random distribution across the entire verified pool.

import.title: Import questions
import.mappingIntro: Found {count} author(s) not present on this system. Choose how to attribute each one's questions.
import.mappingActionStubHint: A placeholder account with only this name — cannot log in
import.mappingActionNullHint: Questions will be owned by you but unattributed
import.mappingUsersUnavailable: Could not fetch the user list (you may lack the user-management capability). "Assign to existing user" is disabled.
import.fileLabel: Drag and drop an Excel / CSV / JSON file here
import.fileHint: Max: 50 MB. Required columns: question, choice_1, choice_2, correct_answer
import.telegramLabel: Drag and drop result.json from Telegram here
import.telegramHint: The file must be exported from Telegram's data export
import.badType: File type not allowed: {ext}. Supported types: {allowed}
import.badTelegramType: Please choose a JSON file only
import.stateLabel: Drag and drop the state file (.json) here
import.stateHint: Includes categories, tags, cases, and questions with images
import.stateModeMerge: Merge — add new questions only, keep existing ones
import.stateModeReplace: Replace — delete all existing questions first
import.stateReplaceWarning: Warning: all existing questions will be permanently deleted. Categories, tags, and cases are kept.
import.statePreviewHint: Counts are estimates — they are recomputed inside the atomic transaction. Images are skipped if their base64 payload cannot be decoded.
